svg.aria-label: What it does. Understands what you sent: Web pages, GitHub repos, YouTube, X posts and PDFs. Dynamic pages render in a real browser. If it can't read the source, the draft says so instead of guessing. Proposes a decision: Not a summary dump. Every item comes back with a type, an intent, a priority and concrete next steps. Waits for your call: The agent pauses until you approve, reject, change a field with one tap, or reply with a note for a redraft. Lands clean in Notion: A Project with linked Tasks. Links already in your backlog are flagged, and Undo is one tap away.
